Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1154198. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1154198'. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
